title: PMGC Holdings Inc. 8-K Filing — Entry into Material Definitive Agreement
summary: PMGC Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: ELAB), a small-cap emerging growth company, entered into a $40 million equity line of credit with an investor on April 16, 2026. The initial Pre-Paid Purchase totaled $10.73 million in principal, yielding net proceeds of approximately $9.73 million after discounts and fees. The agreement carries a 7% original issue discount and 7% annual interest rate, with subsequent purchases subject to a floor price of 20% of the Nasdaq Minimum Price.
key_points: PMGC Holdings Inc. entered into a securities purchase agreement establishing a $40 million equity line of credit on April 16, 2026
Initial Pre-Paid Purchase of $10.73 million principal yielded $10 million in cash ($9.73 million net after fees)
The agreement carries a 7% original issue discount and $30,000 transaction expense reimbursement
Subsequent Pre-Paid Purchases accrue interest at 7% per annum with a 7% OID
Floor price for subsequent purchases is 20% of Nasdaq Minimum Price
Five wholly-owned subsidiaries provided guaranties for the agreement
Commitment Period runs through April 16, 2028 or until $40 million is fully drawn
